meta.audience: makers about to ship a side project
meta.title: Deploy Kit
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from the app: source/README.md, its design tokens (src/styles/base.css in the app repository) and its captured screens. A light launch bench (#ECEEF5) with black type, electric blue #0B2FE6 for what ships, a navy output tray and a little lime; the reel moves like a launch: files stream, pack and leave.

source.notes: a launch bench: one form makes README, LICENSE, CI, deploy config, SEO tags, OG image, favicon and more, live, and packs the chosen ones in one ZIP
the real app (its production build, served locally) captured by capture/app.json, including the output tray before and after a rename; the kit 'Orbit Note' is the app's own fictional example
Pretendard Variable (the app's face) and JetBrains Mono (file names, labels); SIL OFL 1.1

rationale.palette: The app's tokens: bench #ECEEF5 / #F6F7FB, white panels, ink #0A0B10 / #3A3E4C / #5C6172, electric blue #0B2FE6 (the ZIP button, the ZIP tile, the selected stack) with #2748FF and #0720B0, the navy output tray, and lime #D4FF3A for the live dot.
rationale.type: Pretendard Variable at 900 for headlines, black with the second line blue; JetBrains Mono for every file name and label, as the app's tray and stamps use mono ('SHIP CLUB — DEPLOY KIT · LAUNCH BENCH', 'LIVE OUTPUT').
rationale.motion: Launch speed: file names stream upward like exhaust, rows flash UPDATED as the app re-makes them, twenty-five files arc into one ZIP crate on the beat and the crate stamps shut. Fast but readable: every headline holds for most of its scene.
rationale.sound: Drum and bass in G minor at 176 BPM (11 bars in 15 s, 22 in 30 s): the energy of shipping, with digital SFX (key taps, blips as files update, a stamp as the ZIP closes).
rationale.visuals: Four scenes in the 15 s cut: file names stream past the app's logo; a renamed project re-makes twelve files live in the app's real output tray; twenty-five files pack into one ZIP under the app's real bench stats; the end card. The 30 s cut adds the OG image and favicon generators and the launch checklist.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a short, muted launch reel with slogan-length Korean copy shown as type.
